Overview

GWMWater, working with the West Wimmera Shire Council, invested in Goroke to provide a sewerage system. The Goroke Sewerage Scheme provides residents with a reliable, and effective wastewater collection and treatment system. The sewerage scheme used existing septic tanks on properties. This scheme delivers a reliable and effective wastewater collection and treatment system, which contributes to the prosperity and future growth of the town.

For information about the relevant charges that will apply, as well as concessions or subsidies available see our Goroke Sewerage Scheme charges and subsidies overview. If you need more information, or need support to apply for subsidies, please call our Customer Service Team during business hours on 1300 659 961.
